{{Top}}
{{Quote|I have come for the Selection.''"<br />"''Yes, yes, of course. Line up! Heads of each tribe, line up for the sister!|Asajj Ventress and Brother Viscus|<ref name="witches">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
[[File:Selection-Monster.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ventress, amidst the challengers just prior to beginning the Selection ritual]]
The '''Selection''' was a three-ritual series of brutal trials in which the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] chose men from the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] clan to serve as their mates and servants. While the Selection was only for Nightbrothers, the three trials of the Selection were also employed to select Nightsisters ready for full warrior status. Because of the name of the [[Crucible (arena)|arena]] where the trials took place, the Selection was also referred to as "'''the Crucible'''."<ref name=":0">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

==Description==
{{Quote|When the prize is to be the servant of a Sith Lord, elimination equals death.|Asajj Ventress|<ref name=":0" />}}
The ceremony consisted of the [[Test of Fury/Legends|'''Test of Fury''']], the '''[[Test of Night]]''', and the '''[[Test of Elevation]]'''. Failing a single test would eliminate a Nightbrother from the Selection process, or a Nightsister from achieving warrior status. All three trials were held at the arena on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] known as the [[Crucible (arena)|Crucible]]. Success in the trials resulted in "a second beginning" by being assigned to one of three ranks or specializations&mdash;categories of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] skill offered to offworld clients: those of '''''[[Shadow killer/Legends|shadow killer]]''','' '''''[[Hunter (Nightsister)/Legends|hunter]]''''' and '''''[[Warrior (Nightsister)|warrior]]'''.''<ref name=":0" />

It was through this rigorous process of elimination that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] handpicked [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to become her "warrior" agent in a plot against her former master, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>
